name: Rockers International
ownershipStory: Augustus Pablo started Rockers International in 1972, the same year his instrumental 'Java' broke through, to release his own melodica-led productions and those of musicians around him. Like Atkins, May, and Kraftwerk elsewhere in this dataset, Pablo kept ownership of his own catalogue rather than working purely as a hired voice for someone else's label.
hook: Augustus Pablo used his first hit's momentum to start his own label rather than sign away the next one.

blurb.age7: Augustus Pablo started his own record label so he could put out his own music his way.
blurb.age13: Rockers International is the label Augustus Pablo founded in 1972, right after his instrumental 'Java' became a hit, so he could keep control of his own recordings.
blurb.adult: Another instance of the artist-owned-label pattern that recurs across this dataset's most self-directed nodes, here inside a Kingston scene where session musicians were usually paid a flat fee and owned nothing afterward.
